Real artifacts for tests/test_management_ordering.py (item 14: Management ordering, guidance and treatment links).

- `felipe_fb6030ba_treatments_and_events.json`: the ready Treatment names and ready Management events of real run
  `20260918T192235_fb6030ba` (Felipe-2010-Cultivar). None of the events carried `treatment_ids`.
- `felipe_fb6030ba_management_candidates.json`: that run's real free-form Management enumeration candidates
  (id, description, anchors), unmodified.
- `Felipe-2010-Cultivar/`: the real blocks they cite: `b:0028` (land preparation, compost, laser leveling and the
  mustard cover crop planting, all in one paragraph that also names the fallow and mustard main plots), `b:0029`
  (mowing and incorporation) and `b:0030` (cultivars, irrigation, weeding, sulfur).
